about: Per-room-type loot hooks (docs/sandbox/INTERIORS.md 'Loot'): a room's loot id to a table in Constructs/Loot.json. Every room of a type rolls from the same table, so a medical bay holds medical things and an armoury guns, ammunition and weapon parts. The 'room ...' tables are the interiors' own (tier 3, common to rare); null leaves the containers empty. The values are the user's to change.
